title: MuChin: A Chinese Colloquial Description Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models in the Field of Music

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating semantic similarity scores between music descriptions provided by professional musicians and amateur listeners across various dimensions (e.g., genre, emotion, song purpose) to measure interpretative and descriptive discrepancies.

Evaluating and mitigating subjective human judgments in music annotation through a multi-person, multi-stage quality assurance pipeline, inter-annotator agreement scoring, and balanced genre clustering to prevent individual annotator skew.
